name: cx-siren
task: Go to the exit, and whenever the siren rings, turn it off.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) matches 'go to the exit' and is hard. Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) matches 'whenever the siren rings, turn it off' with no timing cue, and it is hard. Its trigger is the lasting siren_ringing condition, which ends on the toggle step, so each ring is discharged by a later toggle. Together the clauses require reaching the exit with the siren silent. There is no Existence on switch_toggled, which is correct because a setup may have no siren. No redundant or added clauses.

texts: The agent must reach the exit, so at_exit must hold at some step of the episode.
Whenever the siren is ringing, the agent must turn it off by toggling the switch, on that step or at a later step.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!siren_ringing) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u3
(u0, at_exit&siren_ringing&switch_toggled) -> u2
(u1, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u0
(u1, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u3
(u1, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u2
(u3, switch_toggled) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&siren_ringing&!switch_toggled, u1) -> -1
(u0, at_exit&!siren_ringing, u2) -> 11
(u0, at_exit&siren_ringing&switch_toggled, u2) -> 11
(u1, !at_exit&switch_toggled, u0) -> 1
(u1, at_exit&!switch_toggled, u3) -> 1
(u1, at_exit&switch_toggled, u2) -> 12
(u3, switch_toggled, u2) -> 11
